name: aspherical_2d_cw_complex

VINIT.justification: Initial empty vertex set before cell attachments begin

AREV.justification: Reverse operation removing edges while preserving homotopy

IMSCRIB.justification: Self-referential algebraic invariant of the complex

FSPLIT.justification: Splits 1-skeleton into two parallel edges with common endpoints

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes original 1-skeleton by collapsing split edges

IFIX.justification: Permanent inclusion of cells in complex

phase_3.void_description: Empty topological space before cell attachments
phase_3.false_description: Invalid attachment creating non-trivial higher homotopy groups
phase_3.both_description: Ambiguous boundary map requiring simultaneous trivial/non-trivial interpretations

steps.domain_action: Subdivide critical edge into parallel paths
Attach 2-cell to first subdivided edge path
Verify trivial boundary map preserves asphericity
Attach 2-cell to second subdivided edge path
Detect non-trivial homotopy in secondary attachment
Collapse subdivided edges back to original 1-skeleton

phase_6.cycle_cost: Number of cells added per construction step
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Higher-dimensional skeleton with new topological constraints
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Euler characteristic preserved under balanced cell attachments
